approval: user approved document-grounded separate reconstruction for all stages

signals.coordinates: first person, NTU25 proxy; re-center joint1 each frame; no world/root translation
signals.scope: P0 whole real clip, P1 each real 64-frame input window independently
signals.scale: median positive torso length ||joint20-joint0|| over scope; epsilon 1e-8
signals.reference: first valid torso unit vector; relative reference axis, NOT gravity
signals.invalid: torso length <=1e-8 yields all twelve zeros; derivatives zero across invalid boundary; no sample excluded
signals.geometry_joints: 0..19, exclude duplicated distal proxy joints20..24 from shape/speed/pose means
channels: pelvis minus ankle midpoint projected onto reference / scale
head minus ankle midpoint projected onto reference / scale
smallest / largest centered shape covariance eigenvalue
mean joint relative speed / scale / second
RMS joint displacement from first valid pose / scale
signals.eigensolver: NumPy float64 CPU eigvalsh, eigenvalues clipped at zero
signals.descriptor_order: channel-major 12x13, linear quantiles; one-frame last statistic zero

p0.standardization: primitive descriptor only, train-fold mean/population std, denominator max(std,1e-6); DSTE unchanged
p0.point_gate: hybrid mean-fold F1 strictly above D0-TS AND at least one fewer lying FP AND no fall TP loss
p0.bootstrap: 10000 paired subject cluster draws stratified within five folds, seed0, percentile95 CI of mean-fold F1 delta; training/selection not repeated
p0.claim: development validation-OOF selected on same held-out folds; exploratory uncertainty, not external or nested generalization

p1.freeze: DSTE/ADL and all F1 hidden parameters in eval mode, including dropout disabled
p1.trainable: zero weight and bias Linear(12,512) plus copied Linear(512,4) classifier
p1.subset: sorted first floor(N/4) indices of torch.randperm(N,generator seed0); no stratification
p1.loss: dense CE using F1 original train unique-covered-frame inverse-sqrt weights; counts [4570626,57983,182231,18056]
p1.signal_standardization: none; scale normalization is intrinsic to signal definitions
p1.selection: F1 validation macro-F1, fall-vs-unstable AUPRC, lying F1; earliest tie, epoch0 eligible
p1.epoch0_gate: bit-exact window logits against same frozen F1 on every validation window before training
p1.test_ood: not evaluated for this feasibility experiment
p1.resume: completed epochs only; frozen eval-mode hidden; deterministic epoch shuffle

newly_specified_not_recovered: P0 matched probe optimizer inherited from reconstruction
point gate thresholds and bootstrap procedure
P1 subset indices, optimizer and loss details
F1 R2 initialization rather than deleted original checkpoint
